faqs.q: Sec. 90-4. - Nuisances and abatement procedures for rubbish and garbage.
faqs.a:
It is the intent of the city to require the removal of rubbish and garbage of all
               kinds from lots and tracts of land within the city in the manner provided by Article
               XI, of
Chapter 18
, Buildings and Building Regulations. Failure to properly remove rubbish and garbage
               shall be sufficient cause for the city to avail itself of the procedures described
               in Division 1, Article III, of
Chapter 38
, Environment.
(Ord. No.
4733
, § 1, 6-15-2020)
